title: Density sum over a fibre with at most M good points (Simon 8.5.10, printed (6) and 5.11(∗))
statement: Assume MonotonicityFormula. Let N, n ∈ ℕ, Λ ≥ 1 and M ∈ ℕ. There is δ' > 0 such that for δ ∈ (0,δ'], ε ∈ (0,δ⁴], every U ⊆ ℝ^N with B°_3(0) ⊆ U, every n-varifold W on U with locally bounded first variation and μ_W(B°_3(0)) ≤ Λ, P ∈ G(N,n), x ∈ ℝ^N, finite s ⊆ ℝ^N with #s ≤ M and Θ : ℝ^N → [0,∞]: if every y ∈ s satisfies p_P(y) = x, y ∈ B_2(0), (1) ‖δW‖(B_ρ(y)) ≤ εμ_W(B_ρ(y)) ∀ρ ∈ (0,1), (2) ∫_{B_ρ(y)×G} t_P dW ≤ ερ^n ∀ρ ∈ (0,1), |y − p_P(y)| < ε and HasDensity n μ_W y (Θ(y)), then Σ_{y∈s} Θ(y) ≤ (1 + δ)μ_W(B_1(x))/ω_n + δ in [0,∞] (ω_n = unitBallVolume n).
